description: One podcast episode from CanonCannon with everything extracted from it — the ideas it raised, its guests, and the books mentioned. Get the slug from canon_episode_search. Requires a CanonCannon API key via _apiKey. Example: canon_episode_get({ slug: "pa-392-sleep-apnea" }).

_apiKey.description: CanonCannon API key (cc_live_...). Every /api/v1 endpoint refuses without it. Keys are issued by CanonCannon — https://canoncannon.com

name: canon_episode_get
title: Canon Episode Get
